caption: The drawing depicts a single large, symmetrical metal hinge placed vertically at the center of the image. The hinge is dark gray or black in color, and its design features two identical mirrored halves joined by a cylindrical pivot in the middle. Each half of the hinge has an ornate shape with sweeping curves and ends that resemble stylized animal heads, possibly dragons, with small circular holes suggesting eyes. Along each side, multiple small rectangular or oval holes are aligned for screws or bolts. Below the main hinge, there is a thin, straight horizontal rod or pin with a circular loop at one end, which is shaded and labeled with a small scale underneath indicating measurements. The background is off-white or beige, and the entire drawing is contained within a fine rectangular border. The name "MILDRED FORD" is inscribed at the bottom left of the image.
title: Hinge
